description: A live circulating rhythm score: track independently varying belts and moving inspection bands while coordinating tap and hold inputs.
name: Polyrhythm Customs V2 · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Clear every circulating note. Press when its filled head is inside its moving gold band; for a ribbon, hold until the hollow tail reaches gold, then release. Missed notes return, but more than 6 missed passes ends the episode. A wrong stamp or mistimed release ends this episode. Use physical A/S/D/F keydown and keyup; keys can be held together. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden-state access. Do not switch to any unrelated, blank, settings, or pre-existing non-task tab. A task-opened tab is allowed only if part of this task, using its visible controls.
